purpose: Teach: 操る/根元/下回る/追いかける/雇わ/不変/定住/外れる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ドローンを操る仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard one of your customers operates drones for work.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Speaking gently, like sharing something observed and delicate. Warm curiosity without interrogation. Eyes steady on Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の木の根元に苔が生えてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: There's moss growing at the roots of that tree by the shop, isn't there.
lines.style: Quiet noticing. Not quite a question—more an offering of something she's observed. Peaceful, almost meditative pace. The tone of someone pointing something small and real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、売上目標を下回る事のないよう頑張ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make sure we don't fall short of the sales goal, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but clear intention. A soft encouragement rather than pressure. Light warmth underneath—this matters to her, and she wants it to matter to Aoi too. Not demanding.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、忘れ物を追いかける形で取りに戻られたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of your customers came back for something they forgot, didn't they.
lines.style: Noticing something that landed with Aoi. Soft recognition. Speaking quietly, like acknowledging a small kindness without making it grand. Thoughtful pause before the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新スタッフを雇われたお話聞いたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard you hired a new staff member.
lines.style: Gentle interest. Curious but not prying. The tone of someone checking in on something that matters to the person they care about. Warm, attentive listening.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様への笑顔は不変でいようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Keep that smile for our customers unchanged, won't you?
lines.style: Tender but sure. A quiet request that carries weight because it comes from genuine care, not demand. Slow, deliberate. Like she's asking Aoi to hold onto something precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海外から日本に定住されたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard one of your customers settled in Japan from overseas.
lines.style: Warm surprise softly delivered. Sharing something she learned that delighted her. Gentle pace, genuine interest in the small life that moves through Aoi's shop.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のスケジュールが外れる事もあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customers don't always keep the same schedule, do they.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment of life's gentle unpredictability. Observant, accepting. Speaking from the understanding that people are fluid, seasons change. Trailing softly—a shared recognition.
